name: HTML Script Formatter
description: A field formatter that outputs the raw field value unescaped (renders HTML/JS) — only for fully-trusted fields.
project_description:
INTRODUCTION 

This module will add field formatter on every field type and profile type in manage display section where user can change the field format

 REQUIREMENTS 

 -No any special requirements.

 INSTALLATION 

Install via /admin/modules

drush en html_script_formatter -y

composer require drupal/html_script_formatter
